messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Incident notification — Hosted EU (eu1) ingress rate-limiter misconfiguration causing elevated 5xx (primarily 503). Detected 2026-03-23 09:12 UTC. Customers may see increased errors for text generation and embeddings. Status page: https://status.redwoodinference.com/incident/INC-2026-03-23-EU1-ingress-503

maya_k: I'm the oncall, starting rollback of the recent rate-limiter policy change now. Will post updates.

liam_s: Observability: saw a sudden spike in ingress rps from embed write traffic at 09:11 UTC. Error rate -> 12% 503s across eu1 at peak. Streaming requests less affected.

jordan_r: Canary rollback started at 09:20 UTC on a subset of POPs. Watchlist: error-rate, 99p latency, token-service latency.

nora_p: Notifying customers via status page + email to enterprise contacts. Draft in #support-distro, will publish a short explainer once we confirm mitigation.

ops-bot: Mitigation in progress: temporary bypass for verified api-keys + rollback of rate-limiter config to previous stable policy. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INC/Ingress+Rate-Limiter+Runbook

maya_k: Rollback applied to canary (eu1-pop-3) at 09:24 UTC. Observability shows error rate halving within 90s. Rolling to remaining POPs.

liam_s: After full rollback at 09:28 UTC error rate dropped to baseline ~0.4% by 09:30 UTC. Token issuance and auth proxy unaffected.

jordan_r: Root-cause initial analysis: a misapplied deploy change doubled the token-bucket multiplier for a particular host-header path which effectively throttled legitimate traffic under burst conditions. Adding a deploy-time validation to prevent non-idempotent modifier changes.

ethan_m: Assigned post-incident owner for RCA: ethan_m. ETA for draft RCA: 48 hours. Will include timeline, root cause, and remediation tickets.

nora_p: Customer comms plan: initial notice published. Follow-up with impact numbers + mitigation details scheduled for 13:00 UTC. CS team notified to escalate any open tickets.

ops-bot: Current status: Mitigated — rollback complete and error rates returned to normal. Monitoring in progress for 60 minutes. Customer impact summary: ~10% of hosted requests in eu1 experienced 503s for ~16 minutes. Full incident details: https://status.redwoodinference.com/incident/INC-2026-03-23-EU1-ingress-503

maya_k: Next actions (short): 1) Add guardrail to deploy pipeline to block multiplier tweaks without a canary flag. 2) Add unit/e2e for rate-limiter config parsing. 3) Adjust alerts to trigger earlier for asymmetric 5xx spikes. liam_s creating tickets now.

liam_s: Created follow-up tickets and linked to RCA placeholder: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INC-2412345. Assigning devs + QA.

jordan_r: Will keep this thread updated if we see any regression. Otherwise we'll close after the monitoring window. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Incident status: Mitigated -> Monitoring. If you observe customer impact or regressions, post here and ping @oncall.
